upheld.detail: callBasket(method, message: Buffer) declares `const message = decodeURIComponent(...)` inside its 'end' handler, which hides the request-body parameter of the same name. It works, but readers can confuse the request bytes with the gRPC status text.

upheld.title: Overflow error message ignores the negative bound
upheld.detail: ThrowMergedQuantityOutOfRange runs when the merged quantity is above int.MaxValue or below int.MinValue. Its message only says the quantities 'add up to more than the largest quantity a basket line can hold', which is false when negative quantities underflow.
